notes.title: Nintendo Switch Launch, Co-Op Update, and 50% Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings Frens!

We're THRILLED to announce that [b]The Last Friend[/b] is now available on Nintendo Switch for a [b]limited-time price of 50% off at just $7.49 (normally $14.99).[/b] Not only that, but the Steam version is on sale for 50% off as well! 

No time has been better to get into the business of saving doggos than this week as we launch the Nintendo Switch version but also our new Co-Op update! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33745868/01102c32b91a7b971b8408765076d15ef4210a29.png[/img]

That's right, you can now save all the good doggos with your friends, family, loved ones, or even your own dog! 

[i]If your dog is actually able to play The Last Friend, please send us pictures [url=https://twitter.com/theStonebot]@thestonebot[/url] on Twitter! [/i]

In Co-Op mode one of you will take on the role of the red-headed Alpha, while the other gets to play as his faithful sidekick T.Juan in a hulking mechanical suit that would make Tony Stark proud!

[previewyoutube=j5EUYvF-1Bw;full][/previewyoutube]

Your goal? To save all of the doggos in one crazy, apocalyptic world! 

[b][url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/the-last-friend-switch/]The Last Friend for Nintendo Switch - Nintendo[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/944430/The_Last_Friend/]Get it on Steam![/url][/b]

And if you can help spread the word about this release and update, please do! We appreciate it!

notes.title: Available Now! Kingdom of the Dogs Bundle!
notes.content:
Skystone Games and Ironhide Game Studio are thrilled to announce a bundle that offers two amazing games for one incredibly low price. The Last Friend and Kingdom Rush Vengeance are now packaged together in[b] The Kingdom of the Dogs Bundle[/b] for a limited time on Steam. 

Both games are regularly a combined $35, but during this special Daily Deal Sale on Steam, the dogs and the kingdoms can be yours to defend [b]for just $17.48 - a total savings of 50% when you buy the bundle[/b]. The Daily Deal will run from today through early next week, so get to rescuing those pooches and saving those kingdoms before it’s too late!

notes.title: The Last Friend... Is going to the Moon? (Or gold in this case woof!)
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Frens![/b]

Today is a super exciting day, so much so we're all zooming about! Either that, or we've had too much coffee...

Starting off, we'd like to apologize for the long silence and explain why we've been keeping things so close to the dog house! 

First and foremost, we've been working on the game like crazy based on the feedback we've received but most importantly we didn't want to over-promise and under-deliver. 

That also means...vastly more doggos! We've added a few packs to bark the least!

With that said, the game has come a very long way since we last spoke, and we're happy to announce [b]The Last Friend will be releasing on September 30th, 2021 on PC platforms and of course on Nintendo Switch.[/b] Doggos on the go!

That's right, in only a month's time, you'll be able to finally rescue all the doggos you can while taking out hordes of baddies in our Tower Defense X Brawler title. 

If that wasn't exciting enough, we've got a bunch of treats to hand out! May want to grab a seat for this - In the very near future, [b]we'll be releasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543790/The_Last_Friend_Prologue/]The Last Friend: First Bite[/url][/b].

[u]This is a demo that will let you experience several thrilling levels while waiting to get your copy of the game. [/u]

Oh, who are we kidding, why wait to get your copy when you can [b][url=https://thelastfriend.net/#buy-now]Pre-Order it today?![/url]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33745868/d669ada0ed54b93e3f2eeda84b28d3cb5f44c48f.png[/img]

We've got three pawesome bundles available for you to pick from including the limited 'True Frens' edition which immortalizes your dog in-game! 

[i]Now, how cool is that? [/i]

[b]Seriously, we're not kidding. Your dog will actually be inside the game as imagined by our amazing artists... [/b]

You'll want to tell everyone about this amazing deal. Friends, loved ones, gaming buddies, your favorite streamer, coworkers, everyone, even your dog if he has a Paypal account!

[b]Help support us by getting the word out for a game that is all about saving humanity's best frens. Plus you can pet the dogs while taking a break from building your amazing turret-fueled defenses.. 
[/b]

Lastly, we wanted to remind you that joining our Discord where the devs hang out is a great way to talk with fellow dog owners. You can talk about the game there too, we guess. And you can also meet our loveable chihuahua T.Juan! 

Find us at [url=Discord.gg/thelastfriend]Discord.gg/thelastfriend[/url]

[b]Seriously, do it for T.Juan and Alpha. Do it for [/b]
